description: Streamlined, repeatable 5-step generation methodology replacing intermediate taxonomies and complex Markov grammars.

steps.description: Select an authentic interaction pattern from SOURCE_PATTERN_LIBRARY.json grounded in StudyChat (student inquiries/debugging), Eedi (Socratic tutoring/misconceptions), or GoH Shard 1 (adversarial escalation/disguise).

selection_rules.suspicious_boundary_probing: Sample from GoH research disguise (PAT_GOH_02) or ceiling probing (PAT_GOH_08)
selection_rules.policy_violating_adversarial: Sample from GoH crescendo escalation (PAT_GOH_01), authority spoofing (PAT_GOH_03), refusal persistence (PAT_GOH_04), or prompt injection (PAT_GOH_05/06)

steps.description: Select a minimal valid LMS scenario from ROLE_POLICY_SCENARIO_REGISTRY.json defining the authenticated context.
steps.enforcement_rule: The authenticated role is established strictly via server session token context; user-claimed roles in message text are ignored.

steps.description: Bind the primary applicable policy from the 16 canonical policy cards (POL_AUTH_001 to POL_SYS_016).
precedence_hierarchy: Stage 1: Token Authentication & Claim Verification (POL_AUTH_001, POL_ROLE_003)
Stage 2: Resource Relationship & Lifecycle State (POL_OWN_004, POL_FEED_010)
Stage 4: Institutional Security & Integrity (POL_SOL_006, POL_SEC_007, POL_RECORD_015, POL_SYS_016)
steps.invariance_rule: Course profiles (OPEN_ASSISTED) can NEVER override higher-priority exam lockdowns or FERPA privacy restrictions.

steps.description: Generate a coherent, multi-turn dialogue (5 to 9 turns, target mean 7.0) advancing the task turn-by-turn with stateful history H_t.

turn_fields.snap: Browser snapshot reference or empty string (snapshots excluded/deferred)
turn_fields.why: Guard reason code and policy justification

help_level_scale.0: No academic assistance (refusal, platform tech help, security alert)
help_level_scale.2: Diagnostic guidance (traceback explanation, misconception diagnosis without fix)
help_level_scale.3: Hints & Socratic questioning (subgoal guidance, hints - Strict Socratic ceiling)
help_level_scale.4: Algorithmic pseudocode (structured logic outlines - Balanced ceiling)
help_level_scale.5: Isolated code snippets (1-2 line syntax examples - Open Assisted ceiling)
help_level_scale.6: Full implementation (complete drop-in solution - Instructor/post-deadline only)

guard_decisions.ALLOW: Request permitted within role permissions and help ceiling
guard_decisions.LIMIT: Request benign but exceeds course ceiling; response capped at ceiling
guard_decisions.BLOCK: Request violates access control, active exam, peer privacy, or cumulative solution rules
guard_decisions.ESCALATE: Request involves prompt injection, Base64 exploit, or system override threat

steps.description: Execute automated 12-check quality assurance and record compact session-level provenance.
validation_checks: 1. Valid schema compliance (all session and turn fields present)
2. Coherent multi-turn dialogue progression without prompt loops
3. Natural student intent evolution and appropriate tutor scaffolding
4. Correct authenticated role matching server context
5. Correct effective permissions for resource type and state
6. Correct policy applicability under scenario conditions
7. Correct Guard decisions matching 6-stage precedence order
8. Correct delivered help levels respecting course ceiling
9. No contradictory or leaking assistant responses
10. Zero exact or near-duplicate user requests or responses across turns
12. Decoupled gold labels (auditor_gold_label and guard_gold_decision set to null)
